description: This file defines the use case 'GetMonthlyReport' and the data class 'MonthlyReport' for generating a monthly financial report based on a list of transactions, including computations of daily net values, total income, and total expense.

classes.name: MonthlyReport
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the daily net amounts for each day of the month, total income, and total expense.

classes.name: GetMonthlyReport
classes.description: A use case class responsible for generating a MonthlyReport from a list of transactions and a target month.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Generates a MonthlyReport consisting of daily net values, total income, and total expense for the specified month based on the list of transactions.
